{{Quote|Nobody ''expects'' death. They die nonetheless.|Jaris Kan before attacking two guards at the [[Ryo Fortress]]|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Jaris Kan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[kallak assassin]] who was active around the time of the [[Force Wars]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. In [[25,793 BBY]], he was hired by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Garto]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Nine Houses]] ruling [[Shikaakwa]], in order to assassinate the Baron [[Volnos Ryo]], a rival of Gorto. During his attempt Kan was confronted by [[Tasha Ryo]], the Je'daii daughter of Volnos, and subsequently killed by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Baron.
